name: Mirra
identity: oasis water diviner; hands empty and open in every clip (water is a scene effect); ivory headwrap with a turquoise gem above the RIGHT ear; turquoise wrist bands; shawl end over the LEFT shoulder
home_region_note: Claude K's proposal on #149 (25 Oct), not yet decided by Matt; it only sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/mirra.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Seep
techniques.binding: passive: stand in one of your own spring seals
techniques.effect: The spring heals her a little each second, for a few seconds per seal.

upgrade.name: Seep II
upgrade.effect: Dodges recharge faster while she stands in a seal.

techniques.name: Undertow
techniques.binding: passive: a water bolt fired through a seal
techniques.effect: The widened bolt pulls light foes one step toward the seal.

upgrade.name: Undertow II
upgrade.effect: Pulled foes are soaked: their next hit taken is stronger.

techniques.name: Curtain Wave
techniques.binding: hold Water curtain for 0.8 s, then let go
techniques.effect: The curtain rolls forward as a wave that pushes foes and projectiles back.

new_clips: guard_wave (6 drawings: from guard 4, both palms push forward)

upgrade.name: Curtain Wave II
upgrade.effect: A spring seal is left where the wave breaks.
